purpose: ADR-136 addendum of 11.10.2026: the free yardstick for the court deadline. The questions and search plans of ten stored turns about a decision the person does not accept (search-assist-14, paid checks of 10.10.2026) and two control turns, replayed by the search gate. Deciding phrases, in this order: the deadline for going to court in the Code of Administrative Court Procedure (§ 46 lõige 1, § 47 lõige 2) and the deadline for a challenge (Administrative Procedure Act § 75). The gate tells for each plan whether the passages are among the candidates the selection reads. No model call. The saved query vectors are on the server (rag-v2-work/eval-files/decision-challenge-1/vectors.json).
